title: JukeboxVolumeControl
description: adds controls for jukeboxes like changing volume and other stuff
body:
This mod adds controls to jukeboxes like changing volume, pitch, and others!

these settings are per jukebox too.

say you have a shop and you want music, but jukeboxes are too loud, you can turn it down now!

shift click any jukeboxes for settings![config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/670203488889bf6df7ccb3d38f02b849fe63cdd7_0.webp)
